SELECT V.VENDOR_CODE AS "VENDOR_CODE" , V.VENDOR_NAME AS "VENDOR_NAME" , IM.ITEM_CODE AS "ITEM_CODE" , IM.ITEM_NAME AS "ITEM_NAME" , IM.HS_CODE AS "D_HS_CODE" , ECD.HS_CODE AS "HS_CODE" , ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO AS "COO_CERTIFY_NO" , ECD.APPLY_DATE AS "APPLY_DATE" , ECD.END_DATE AS "END_DATE" , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ECD.APPLY_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ECD.END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "COO_PERIOD" , FM.FTA_NAME AS "FTA_NAME" , ECD.RULE_CODE AS "RULE_CODE" , CASE WHEN ECD.COO_YN = 'Y' THEN '충족' WHEN ECD.COO_YN = 'N' THEN '불충족' ELSE ECD.COO_YN END AS "COO_YN" FROM EXT_COO_CERTIFY_MST ECM INNER JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_DTL ECD ON ECD.COO_CERTIFY_NO = ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO AND ECD.VENDOR_CODE = ECM.VENDOR_CODE AND ECD.DIVISION_CODE = ECM.DIVISION_CODE AND ECD.COMPANY_CODE = ECM.COMPANY_CODE INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.ITEM_CODE = ECD.ITEM_CODE AND IM.COMPANY_CODE = ECD.COMPANY_CODE INNER JOIN VENDOR V ON V.VENDOR_CODE = ECM.VENDOR_CODE AND V.COMPANY_CODE = ECM.COMPANY_CODE INNER JOIN FTA_MASTER FM ON FM.FTA_CODE = ECD.FTA_CODE WHERE ECM.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND ECM.SUBMIT_STATUS = '4'
AND #{SCH_APPLY_DATE} BETWEEN ECD.APPLY_DATE AND ECD.END_DATE
AND UPPER(IM.ITEM_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{search_key_word}) || '%'
AND UPPER(IM.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{search_key_word}) || '%'
AND UPPER(V.VENDOR_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{search_key_word}) || '%'
AND UPPER(V.VENDOR_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{search_key_word}) || '%'
AND UPPER(ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{search_key_word}) || '%'
AND ECD.COO_YN = #{cover_yn}
ORDER BY V.VENDOR_CODE , IM.ITEM_CODE , FM.FTA_NAME
